name: Donal, Herald of Wings
oracle_text: Whenever you cast a nonlegendary creature spell with flying, you may copy it, except the copy is a 1/1 Spirit in addition to its other types. Do this only once each turn. (The copy becomes a token.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a nonlegendary creature spell with flying, you may copy it, except the copy is a 1/1 Spirit in addition to its other types. Do this only once each turn

needs.what: an `except` modifier on copy_spell (707.9) that overrides copiable values of the spell copy: base power/toughness set to 1/1 and the Spirit subtype added in addition to its other types, carried onto the token permanent the copy resolves into
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_spell accepts only amount, controller, new_targets, sid, spells, target and this_spell; put_copy_on_stack copies the original verbatim, so there is no way to make the copy a 1/1 Spirit. copy_permanent has except/except_ but copies a permanent, not a spell on the stack, and become_copy/animate act on permanents after the fact, which would be a different card. The 'do this only once each turn' limit (the optional copy, not the trigger) is also distinct from trigger max_per_turn, which caps triggering rather than the accepted copy
